opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households in Scotland who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government; ordinarily resident in Scotland with at least two years of secondary schooling/college education in Scotland or a substantial recent connection to Scotland; enrolled/offered a place on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution; not eligible for public funds for tuition fees.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to cover undergraduate tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for government tuition fee support, studying for a first degree (or in limited cases a second degree) at a Scottish higher education institution.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie-Morgan Scholarship

amount.raw: Full tuition fees for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants plus an additional living-cost bursary of £1,200.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scottish-domiciled students from low-income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, accepted onto the MSc Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants delivered by Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh and University of Edinburgh; must not have already obtained a postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: Scholarship developed in partnership with the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh covering full tuition fees and a £1,200 living-cost bursary for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants, to widen participation in postgraduate plant science study and support Scotland's net-zero and biodiversity workforce.
